title: Pixel 11 Pro Fold is changing how I multitask on a foldable with ‘App Handles’ [Gallery]
summary: Previewed in a recent Canary build, Google’s Pixel 11 Pro Fold ships with the “App Handles” multitasking feature that’s a welcome addition to the experience. Built on top of “Bubbles,” this new “App Handles” feature is essentially a dock for floating windows.
